pulse.text: **Still nothing shipped** — docs.x.ai re-checked at 9 PM Sep 19 ends at **grok-4.6**, leaving Grok 4.7 roughly **36 hours** to make its 96% Sep-21 Manifold leg or that market resolves no. The biggest odds move this sweep is Google's: Gemini 3.5 Pro's **Oct-15 leg slid to 40% from 47** while the Oct-31 leg holds at 85%, meaning traders are pushing the next frontier Gemini later inside October rather than off the calendar. Anthropic tightened again on the near-term ranking — **98.4% for best model at end of September** with 11 days left, 89% for October, 73% at year-end — and the Arena-ceiling bet cooled a touch, 1530+ Elo by Dec 31 at 33% from 34. Off the leaderboards the slowdown fight went macro: CNBC confirmed Trump will name an **AI czar** alongside Saturday's "AI Force" post, and last week's Fed quarter-point hike plus AI-safety fears knocked **Intel and Micron each over 5%** and GE Vernova about 9% before buyers came back. Watch Sunday: either Grok 4.7 finally lands or a 96% market breaks.
